summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: US futures are mixed after Monday's selloff, with Nasdaq-100 futures up 0.23% and S&P 500 futures down 0.20% versus the previous cash-close reference. October retail sales rose 0.2% month over month; import and export prices each rose 1.1%. Nvidia's results remain due after the close. Higher Treasury yields and oil prices complicate the attempted technology recovery.
summary.zh: 信息截至纽约时间09:00 EST：周一抛售后，美股期货涨跌互现，纳指100和标普500期货较上一交易日美股常规收盘时的参考值分别上涨0.23%、下跌0.20%。已公布的10月零售销售环比增0.2%，进口、出口价格均环比涨1.1%。英伟达财报仍待盘后发布，美债收益率与油价走高增加科技板块修复的不确定性。

title.en: October retail and food-services sales rise 0.2% month over month
title.zh: 美国10月零售与餐饮销售环比增0.2%

impact.en: The Census Bureau's 08:30 EST release puts October retail and food-services sales at $748.2B, up 0.2% monthly and 6.8% annually. September's 0.8% monthly gain was unrevised. Estimates are adjusted for seasonality and calendar effects, but not inflation; the monthly estimate's ±0.4 percentage-point margin includes zero.
impact.zh: 人口普查局08:30 EST公布，10月零售与餐饮销售额$748.2B，环比增0.2%、同比增6.8%；9月环比增0.8%未修正。数据已作季节和日历因素调整，未剔除价格变动的影响；月度估计的误差范围为±0.4个百分点，包含零。

bullish: 名义销售额仍高于上年同期 / Nominal sales remain above the year-earlier level.
bearish: 月度增速较9月放缓 / Monthly growth slowed from September.

macroRisk.en: Nominal sales do not measure inflation-adjusted consumption. The monthly change is not statistically distinguishable from zero at the stated confidence level.
macroRisk.zh: 名义销售不等于实际消费增长；按公布的置信水平，月度变化与零没有统计显著差异。

title.en: October import and export prices each rise 1.1% month over month
title.zh: 美国10月进口、出口价格均环比涨1.1%

impact.en: The BLS release at 08:30 EST reports October import prices up 1.1%, matching September's monthly pace, and export prices up 1.1% after September's 2.4% increase. Nonfuel import prices rose 0.8%. These are published results, distinct from the earlier 0.7% import and 0.5% export forecasts in the morning overview.
impact.zh: 劳工统计局08:30 EST公布，10月进口价格环比涨1.1%，与9月涨幅相同；出口价格环比涨1.1%，前月涨2.4%。非燃料进口价格环比涨0.8%。以上为已公布结果，应与早间综述中进口涨0.7%、出口涨0.5%的此前预测区分。

bullish: 出口价格月度涨幅低于9月 / Monthly export-price growth slowed from September.
bearish: 非燃料进口价格继续上涨 / Nonfuel import prices continued rising.

macroRisk.en: Trade-price indexes differ from CPI and PCE. October 2025 survey gaps prevent publication of some October 2026 year-over-year changes; do not infer missing annual rates.
macroRisk.zh: 贸易价格指数不同于CPI和PCE；2025年10月调查缺口使部分2026年10月同比变化无法公布，不能自行推算缺失同比值。

title.en: US import-restriction plans reported; Home Depot and Disney post higher adjusted earnings
title.zh: 据报道美国推进进口限制计划；家得宝与迪士尼调整后盈利增长

impact.en: MT Newswires reports that the administration is advancing plans to block Chinese data-center equipment imports, citing a Reuters report based on briefed sources. The same overview says Home Depot's fiscal Q3 adjusted earnings and sales rose, as did Disney's fiscal Q4 adjusted earnings and revenue. Proposed restrictions could affect technology supply chains if finalized.
impact.zh: MT Newswires援引路透社知情来源报道，政府正推进阻止中国数据中心设备进口的计划；同篇综述称，家得宝第三财季调整后盈利和销售额、迪士尼第四财季调整后盈利和营收均增长。若限制最终落地，可能影响科技供应链。

bullish: Nasdaq-100 futures rose 0.23% before the open. Home Depot and Disney both reported higher adjusted earnings. / 纳指 100 期货盘前上涨 0.23%。家得宝与迪士尼均报告调整后盈利增长。
bearish: The Trump administration was moving to block Chinese data-center equipment imports. Brent rose 1.41% and WTI rose 1.59%. / 特朗普政府拟阻止进口中国数据中心设备，布伦特原油上涨 1.41%，WTI 原油上涨 1.59%。

macroRisk.en: Oil futures up (Brent +1.41%, WTI +1.59%) could pressure consumer spending and corporate margins.
macroRisk.zh: 原油期货走高（布伦特+1.41%、WTI+1.59%）可能挤压消费支出和企业利润率。

title.en: Nvidia fiscal Q3 report after close seen as pivotal test for AI semiconductor trade; Anthropic IPO expected Thursday
title.zh: 英伟达盘后发布第三季度财报被视为AI半导体交易的关键考验；Anthropic预计周四上市

impact.en: Nvidia's report and interim CEO Colette Kress's commentary on AI capex sustainability will be a key signal for whether the semiconductor sector is bottoming. A weak guide or cautious tone could extend the correction, while a confident outlook may trigger a relief bounce in AI-linked names.
impact.zh: 英伟达的财报及临时CEO Colette Kress对AI资本开支可持续性的评论，将成为半导体板块是否见底的关键信号。若指引偏弱或语气谨慎，可能延续调整；若前景乐观，可能带动AI相关个股反弹。

bullish: 据LSEG，标普500半导体及设备组2026年盈利预计增约125%，属于预测 / LSEG expects about 125% earnings growth for the S&P 500 semiconductor and equipment group in 2026; this is a forecast.
bearish: SOX较6月底峰值跌34%；英伟达较10月6日纳指高点时跌近35% / SOX is down 34% from its late-June peak; Nvidia is down nearly 35% since the October 6 Nasdaq high.

macroRisk.en: 10-year Treasury yield up 2bp to 5.141% adds mild valuation pressure on growth and AI-linked stocks.
macroRisk.zh: 10年期美债收益率上行2个基点至5.141%，对成长股和AI相关个股估值构成轻微压力。

ai.en: AIQ ETF down 3.2% Monday; Nvidia reports fiscal Q3 after close; Anthropic IPO expected Thursday on Nasdaq.
ai.zh: AIQ ETF周一跌3.2%；英伟达盘后发布第三季度财报；Anthropic预计周四在纳斯达克上市。

semiconductor.en: SOXX down 5.45% Monday; SOX index down 34% from late-June peak but still up 35% YTD; BofA sees SOX within 10-15% of a potential trough.
semiconductor.zh: SOXX周一跌5.45%；SOX指数自6月底峰值下跌34%但年内仍涨35%；美银认为SOX 指数距离潜在底部仍有约 10% 至 15% 的下行空间。

bigTech.en: QQQ fell 2.65% at Monday's close. Today's overview reports plans to restrict Chinese data-center equipment imports; a separate Monday report discussed a rule covering remote access to advanced US AI chips.
bigTech.zh: QQQ周一收盘跌2.65%。今日综述报道限制中国数据中心设备进口的计划；另一篇周一报道涉及限制远程访问美国先进AI芯片的规则。

keyRisk.en: Retail sales and import/export prices have been released at 08:30 EST. October industrial production remains scheduled for 09:15 EST at this cutoff, while Nvidia's results are due after the close. Watch cash-market breadth and semiconductor participation.
keyRisk.zh: 零售销售和进出口价格已于08:30 EST公布；在本截点，10月工业生产仍待09:15 EST发布，英伟达财报待盘后公布。关注现货开盘后的市场广度与半导体参与情况。

note.en: I lean toward an uneven recovery attempt after Monday's selloff. Nasdaq-100 futures are up 0.23%, but S&P 500 and Dow futures are down 0.20% and 0.82%, so participation is narrow. The 10-year yield is up 2 basis points to 5.141%, the dollar gains 0.10%, and Brent rises 1.41%, creating a less supportive rate and cost backdrop. Retail sales grew 0.2% monthly in nominal terms, while import prices rose 1.1%; neither figure alone establishes real-demand strength or the next policy decision. Watch the cash open: broader gains including semiconductors with stable yields would support recovery; a fading Nasdaq lead alongside higher yields would weaken it.
note.zh: 我倾向于将盘前表现视为周一抛售后的不均衡修复尝试。纳指100期货涨0.23%，但标普500和道指期货跌0.20%、0.82%，参与面仍窄。10年期收益率上升2个基点至5.141%，美元涨0.10%，布伦特涨1.41%，利率与成本背景对修复的支持有限。零售销售名义值环比增0.2%，进口价格环比涨1.1%；单项数据都不足以确定实际需求强弱或下一次政策决定。关注现货开盘后：若半导体参与、涨势扩散且收益率稳定，将支持修复；若纳指领先优势消退而收益率上行，则会削弱这一判断。
